question: After the two state-safety defects are fixed, should RFC 0016's Claw-managed workspace-file lifecycle continue as an OpenClaw core experimental feature?
rationale: This protected pull request is one slice of an open multi-PR RFC that adds a new core lifecycle and durable state surface; code review can identify defects but cannot authorize that product direction.

options.title: Repair and continue the RFC stack
options.body: Fix canonical schema ownership and post-write failure tracking, then review this slice as the core experimental workspace-file owner.

options.title: Pause the core lifecycle
options.body: Keep the stack draft until maintainers narrow or reject the Claws product direction and durable ownership model.

recommendation.title: Repair and continue the RFC stack
recommendation.body: Fix canonical schema ownership and post-write failure tracking, then review this slice as the core experimental workspace-file owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared-state and fs-safe boundary history points here, and the protected core RFC needs an explicit product decision.
